title: Nami Matcha x Fenty Beauty | Lip Cravings Kit
body_html:
When two female founders link up, it's double the sweetness, double the shine. Fenty Beauty teamed up with Ashley Alexander, founder of Nami Matcha, to whisk together a collaboration that satisfies your everyday lip cravings, all while celebrating female entrepreneurship. Pour up a silky strawberry matcha, swipe on a sparkly pink gloss + call it your new daily ritual.

Plus, show off your obsession with a Gloss Bomb keychain in an exclusive bright matcha green.

This limited-edition set has everything you need from shine to treat, so you can feel your best while looking your best - and that's tea.

NAMI MATCHA STRAWBERRY MATCHA TIN
Origin: Kagoshima, Japan
Tasting Notes: Strawberry, Sweet, Floral
Store matcha in a cool, dry place. Keep tin tightly shut and avoid exposing the matcha to sunlight for longevity.
Made with 100% natural strawberry flavor and no added sugar
1.06 oz

GLOSS BOMB UNIVERSAL LIP LUMINIZER IN "FU$$Y"
Explosive, non-sticky shine
Strengthens lips’ moisture barrier
Locks in moisture + nourishes lips
Infused with Shea Butter, Vitamin E + Peptide
90% agree it feels instantly conditioning**
XXL wand for easy application
Irresistible peach-vanilla scent

**based on a study with 34 participants after immediate use


WHAT ELSE?!
Keep your Gloss Bomb cozy with an exclusive bright matcha-green Gloss Bomb keychain. | Fill Weight: 9 mL

 



CARE INSTRUCTIONS:

NAMI MATCHA STRAWBERRY MATCHA:
Soak your whisk in water for at least 30 seconds.
Whisk 4g matcha with 45ml water.
Add to cup with 120ml milk + 15ml sweetener of your choice.

GLOSS BOMB UNIVERSAL LIP LUMINIZER:
Use XXL wand to coat lips in one easy swipe.
Use alone or as a lipstick topper.
